description: Turns a set of lab values, for example from a type 2 diabetes, kidney, lupus or cancer-survivor check-up, into guideline-cited suggestions and questions for the care team (ADA, KDIGO, EULAR/ACR, NCCN). Made-up or de-identified values only. Returns PRISM 2's quick reading in about 10–20 seconds: a health picture (connections graded and sourced, what is due, safety notes, what is unknown), checked by an independent review, plus the recommendations. For the deepest reading on our strongest model, use start_lab_analysis. For research/education with SYNTHETIC or de-identified data only. Do NOT submit protected health information (PHI). Inputs are not stored, except that a claim link, when offered, holds the submitted values for up to 30 minutes so the person can add them to their own account; unclaimed values are then deleted.

age.description: Age in years of the synthetic persona (improves reference-range interpretation).

biologicalSex.description: Biological sex of the synthetic persona (sex-specific reference ranges).

biomarkers.description: Map of biomarker name -> numeric value, e.g. { "Hemoglobin A1c": 5.4 }. SYNTHETIC ONLY.

include_partner_options.description: If true, include partner/product options. Default false.

name: explain_my_lab_results

claim_panel.description: OPTIONAL owner handoff: attach these exact values to the owner's Phi Longevity account (sign-in + explicit confirm). Present only when the consent bridge is enabled.

claim_url.description: One-click claim link — share ONLY with your owner.

expires_at_ms.description: Epoch ms when the unclaimed panel is hard-deleted.

full_report.description: How the agent's owner can get a complete PRISM report.

for_your_owner.description: ACTION: surface get_full_report_url to the person you are helping.

get_full_report_url.description: Signup link for the agent's owner to get a complete PRISM report.

health_picture.description: PRISM 2: the story, connections graded Established / Likely / Worth asking, questions for the doctor with urgency, tests due, safety notes, what is unknown.

meta.description: Engine metadata for this analysis run.
